verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside Financial Connections that users can delegate tasks to. The Stripe MCP server serves external AI agents, and the 'Financial insights for agents' use case describes agents that developers build on the data. Both are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
